Content.SourceString: 薄荷，米格尔区这边最近好像出现了一个赛车异象，管理局开始处理了吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Hey Mint, I heard there's a racing anomaly that showed up in the Miguel District recently. Has the Bureau started handling it yet?

Content.SourceString: 什么什么，可可？
Content.LocalizedString: Wait what? Coco?

Content.SourceString: 哦！你是说「别让我停下！」吧？我们正在头疼呢！
Content.LocalizedString: Oh! You mean "Don't Let Me Stop!"? We're in the middle of a major headache right now!

Content.SourceString: 最近这段时间，我们接到了好多市民的求助，说自己的车被这个「别让我停下！」贴上了「败北贴纸」，让我们赶快解决。
Content.LocalizedString: Recently, we've been flooded with calls from citizens begging for help. They're saying this "Don't Let Me Stop!" thing is slapping "Loser's Marks" on their cars and they want us to fix it ASAP!

Content.SourceString: 但是啊，这个异象实在是太太太——难对付了！只有跑赢它才能把它泯除，但它的赛车技术太强了……几天下来，连我们异象管理局公务用车的车标都丢了好几个！
Content.LocalizedString: But this anomaly is just sooooo—impossible to deal with! The only way to nullify it is by beating it in a race, but its driving skills are too advanced… In just a few days, even our official BAC vehicles have lost several of their emblems!

Content.SourceString: 我们打算拜托职业公路车手解决，但是有实力的车手最近都在备战「兰斯巡回大奖赛」，日程安排协调不过来，只能暂时先搁置一下……
Content.LocalizedString: We were planning to ask professional street racers for help, but all the skilled drivers are busy preparing for the Reims Grand Prix right now. We couldn't work around their schedules, so we had to put this on hold for now…

Content.SourceString: 这样啊……
Content.LocalizedString: I see…

Content.SourceString: 薄荷，关于刚刚说的「别让我停下！」，我打算试试去泯除。
Content.LocalizedString: Mint, about that "Don't Let Me Stop!" anomaly you just mentioned—I'm going to try nullifying it myself.

Content.SourceString: 你去泯除是指……要去和它比赛吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Wait, when you say you'll nullify it… you mean you're going to race against it?

Content.SourceString: 嗯。
Content.LocalizedString: Mhm.

Content.SourceString: 可可，你也太厉害了吧！连飙车也是异象猎人需要掌握的技能吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Coco, you're seriously amazing! Is street racing another skill that Anomaly Hunters need to master?

OptionText.LocalizedString: It's just a personal interest of mine.

Content.SourceString: 可可可可！碎雪出了新品哦！听说很好吃！
Content.LocalizedString: Coco, Coco! Blizzi has new products! I heard they're super delicious!

Content.SourceString: 什么新品？
Content.LocalizedString: What new product?

Content.SourceString: 薄巧冰淇淋！而且第二份半价，要不要一起去吃？我请你！
Content.LocalizedString: Chocolate mint ice cream! And the second one's half price! Wanna go get some together? My treat!

Content.SourceString: 听起来还不错，可以试试看。
Content.LocalizedString: Sounds pretty good, I'm willing to give it a try.

Content.SourceString: 嘿嘿，就知道你会这么说！我已经在伊波恩门口等你啦！
Content.LocalizedString: Hehe, I knew you'd say that! I'm already waiting for you at Eibon's entrance!

Content.SourceString: 什么？
Content.LocalizedString: What?

Content.SourceString: 一起吃冰淇淋吧(σ′?`)σ
Content.LocalizedString: Let's get some ice cream together! (σ´∀`)σ

Content.SourceString: 一起吃冰淇淋吧(σ′?`)σ
Content.LocalizedString: Let's get some ice cream together! (σ´∀`)σ

Content.SourceString: 可可，本来约好今天一起出去玩的，但我可能来不了了……
Content.LocalizedString: Coco, we were supposed to hang out today, but I don't think I can make it…

Content.SourceString: 怎么了？
Content.LocalizedString: What's wrong?

Content.SourceString: 最近一场考试我又没通过，得准备补考T^T今天要待在办公室里背书。
Content.LocalizedString: I failed another test recently, so I have to prepare for a makeup exam T^T… I'm stuck in the office today memorizing textbooks.

Content.SourceString: 但这样的话，我今天就没别的事可做了……
Content.LocalizedString: But if that's the case, I don't have anything else planned for today…

Content.SourceString: ><对不起！！
Content.LocalizedString: >< Sorry!

Content.SourceString: 没事没事，要不我来找你吧？说不定我能帮上忙。
Content.LocalizedString: No worries at all. Why don't I come find you instead? Maybe I can help out somehow.

Content.SourceString: 好诶好诶！确实，一个人背书真的好无聊！
Content.LocalizedString: Yes, yes! You're absolutely right! Studying alone is soooo boring!

Content.SourceString: 那我在管理局大厅等你！
Content.LocalizedString: Then I'll wait for you in the lobby in BAC!

Content.SourceString: 那我在管理局大厅等你！
Content.LocalizedString: Then I'll wait for you in the lobby in BAC!

Content.SourceString: 你在伊波恩吗，可可~我带了一些香氛喷雾给你！
Content.LocalizedString: Coco! Are you at Eibon? I brought you some scented sprays!

Content.SourceString: 怎么突然买香氛？
Content.LocalizedString: Why the sudden interest in scented sprays?

Content.SourceString: 路上遇到香氛抽抽乐活动，抽到颜色一样的香氛就能再抽一支，不知不觉就连续抽到一小箱。
Content.LocalizedString: I came across this scented spray lucky draw on my way here! If you get two sprays of the same color, you win another draw. Before I knew it, I'd won a whole box full of them!

Content.SourceString: 好可怕的运气……
Content.LocalizedString: That's some terrifying luck…

Content.SourceString: 我一个人用不过来，就想着送一些给你。我已经到伊波恩啦！
Content.LocalizedString: I can't possibly use all of these myself, so I thought I'd share some with you. I'm already at Eibon!

Content.SourceString: 谢啦！我这就来找你。
Content.LocalizedString: Thanks! I'll come find you right away.

Content.SourceString: 谢啦！我这就来找你。
Content.LocalizedString: Thanks! I'll come find you right away.

Content.SourceString: 好烦好烦，再解决不掉它，这个月又要被扣绩效了！！
Content.LocalizedString: It's so frustrating! If we don't solve this soon, my performance bonus is going to get cut again this month!!

Content.SourceString: 哭哭
Content.LocalizedString: *sobbing*

Content.SourceString: 别担心，一定会有办法的。
Content.LocalizedString: Don't worry. We'll definitely find a way.

Content.SourceString: 星星眼
Content.LocalizedString: *starry-eyed*

Content.SourceString: 只是个人兴趣。
Content.LocalizedString: It's just a personal interest of mine.

Content.SourceString: 不要说「只是」呀，能擅长自己喜欢的事可是很厉害的！
Content.LocalizedString: Don't say "just"! Being good at something you love is totally awesome!

Content.SourceString: 我明明也不讨厌上收容组的培训课，可一上考场就忘光了……
Content.LocalizedString: I don't even hate the Containment Units training classes, but the moment I sit for an exam, my mind goes completely blank…

Content.SourceString: 为了伊波恩！
Content.LocalizedString: For Eibon!

Content.SourceString: 毕竟伊波恩接到的委托总是五花八门。
Content.LocalizedString: After all, Eibon gets all kinds of commissions thrown at them!

Content.SourceString: 这么一想，异象猎人的技术含量真的很高……
Content.LocalizedString: When you think about it, being an Anomaly Hunter really does require some serious skills…

Content.SourceString: 我准备今晚去找「别让我停下！」，可以拜托管理局帮忙清场吗？
Content.LocalizedString: I'm planning to track down "Don't Let Me Stop!" tonight. Could the Bureau to help clear the area?

Content.SourceString: 如果有普通市民的车辆不小心驶入竞速路段的话，可能很危险。
Content.LocalizedString: It could be dangerous if civilian vehicles accidentally enter the race route.

Content.SourceString: 包在我身上吧可可！
Content.LocalizedString: I've got this, Coco!

Content.SourceString: 赌上这个月的绩效，我绝对会让你们的比赛顺顺利利进行！
Content.LocalizedString: I stake my performance bonus on it—I'll make absolutely sure your race goes off without a hitch!

Content.SourceString: 谢谢
Content.LocalizedString: Thank you

Content.SourceString: 热血
Content.LocalizedString: *passionate fervor*

Content.SourceString: 呼叫可可！这里是薄荷队员，收到请回答！
Content.LocalizedString: Calling Coco! This is Mint, please respond!

Content.SourceString: 收到，这里是{0}，薄荷请讲。
Content.LocalizedString: Copy that, this is {0}. Go ahead, Mint.

Content.SourceString: 我该配合吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Should I play along?

Content.SourceString: 配合我一下啦可可！这样显得我很傻！>口<
Content.LocalizedString: Come on, Coco! Work with me here! You're making me look stupid! >.<

Content.SourceString: 咳咳，我现在在「别让我停下！」要上山的路口，J.T.F的大家已经完成清场啦！
Content.LocalizedString: *cough cough* I'm at the mountain road entrance where "Don't Let Me Stop!" will be coming through! The JTF team has finished clearing the area!

Content.SourceString: 谢谢你，薄荷，帮大忙了。
Content.LocalizedString: Thank you, Mint. You've been a huge help.

Content.SourceString: 嘿嘿，不用谢我，本来就是我们的分内之事嘛！
Content.LocalizedString: Hehe, no need to thank me! It's just part of our job after all!

Content.SourceString: 啊，正发着消息，就看到「别让我停下！」出现了！朝着山上冲过去了！
Content.LocalizedString: Ah! I was just texting when "Don't Let Me Stop!" showed up! They're racing up the mountain!

Content.SourceString: 好，我这就来。
Content.LocalizedString: Alright, I'm on my way.

Content.SourceString: 呜……近距离看它真的好快！可可，加油啊！
Content.LocalizedString: Whoa… it's so fast up close! You can do it, Coco!

Content.SourceString: 可可，你看到了吗？外面下雪了！真奇特呢……夏天竟然在下雪！
Content.LocalizedString: Coco, did you see that? It's snowing outside! How strange… it's actually snowing in summer!

Content.SourceString: 真想痛痛快快玩一通雪呢~可是局里的人说这是由异象泯除引发的「突发性季节紊乱」，让我们好好调查！
Content.LocalizedString: I really want to have a blast playing in the snow! But the people at headquarters say this is "sudden seasonal disruption" caused by anomaly nullification, so we need to investigate properly!

Content.SourceString: 我刚刚做了做功课，资料上说：不少异象在发动完自身能力后就会自我泯除，但泯除之后能力还能维持这么久、范围这么广的……并不多见呢！
Content.LocalizedString: I just did some homework, and the data says that many anomalies undergo self-nullification after using their abilities, but for the effects to last this long and cover such a wide area after nullification… that's pretty rare!

Content.SourceString: 唉，所以这场夏天的雪该从哪里查起啊？根本毫无线索嘛！
Content.LocalizedString: Ugh, so where do we even start investigating this summer snow? We have absolutely no leads!

Content.SourceString: 对啦可可，你经过每条街区时可以留意下……不知道是不是我的错觉。
Content.LocalizedString: Oh right, Coco, when you pass through each block, could you pay attention to… I don't know if it's just my imagination.

Content.SourceString: 这场雪不论走到哪里，都会有不同的口味欸？
Content.LocalizedString: This snow has different flavors no matter where you go, doesn't it?

Content.SourceString: 呜，异象管理局附近的……是像工作一般苦涩的咖啡味呢！
Content.LocalizedString: Ugh, the snow near the Bureau of Anomaly Control… tastes like bitter coffee, just like work!

Content.SourceString: 可可！你最近有空吗？我们一起去吃顿好吃的吧！
Content.LocalizedString: Cocooooo! U free anytime soon? Let's go grab some yummy food together!!!

Content.SourceString: 我请客！必须好好犒劳犒劳自己！
Content.LocalizedString: My treat!!! I absolutely NEED to reward myselffffff!

Content.SourceString: 有特别想吃的店吗？要不卜多力？这种时候，就是要把那张宝贝的豪华套餐券给用掉！
Content.LocalizedString: Any restaurant u really wanna try? How about Budori?? This is EXACTLY the perfect time to use that precious luxury meal voucher I've been savinggggg!

Content.SourceString: 发生了什么好事？
Content.LocalizedString: What's the good news?

Content.SourceString: 竖起耳朵。
Content.LocalizedString: I'd better listen up.

Content.SourceString: 呜，我倒也想多发生点类似于：
Content.LocalizedString: Ughhh, I wish something more exciting happened, like:

Content.SourceString: 薄荷！恭喜你被评为收容组上月最佳员工！
Content.LocalizedString: "Mint! Congratulations on being named Employee of the Month in the Containment Units!!!"

Content.SourceString: 涨薪了哟薄荷，说明你已经是我们收容组最能干的组员啦。
Content.LocalizedString: "You're getting a raise, Mint! This just proves you're the most capable member in our Containment Units!!!"

Content.SourceString: 好消息薄荷！这次考试你通过了！前辈特意为你带了奶茶庆祝！
Content.LocalizedString: "Great news, Mint! You passed the exam! We brought you milk tea to celebrate with you!"

Content.SourceString: 类似这样的好事哇！
Content.LocalizedString: I wish AMAZING stuff like that would happen to meeeee!

Content.SourceString: 实际如何？
Content.LocalizedString: So what really happened?

Content.SourceString: 实际，实际上是……我刚刚补考完……嘿嘿，要好好放松放松。
Content.LocalizedString: The truth, the truth is… I just finished my make-up exam… Hehehe, gotta treat myself and unwindddd.

Content.SourceString: 一场考下来，尾巴上的毛都变得干枯毛糙了，必须要先补足体力，再用「蓬绒绒尾巴护理喷雾」好好梳理才行！
Content.LocalizedString: After that exam, my tail fur's all dry and frizzyyy! I NEED to recharge first, then use my "Fluffy Tail Care Spray" to groom it properly!!!

Content.SourceString: 不管怎么说，我已经拼尽全力啦！呼……认真背了条例，考前也诚心向我的护身符祈愿过了。上次不灵，这次再给它一次机会！
Content.LocalizedString: Anywayyyy, I gave it my absolute ALL! *sigh* Studied the regulations seriously, and even prayed to my lucky charm before the exam. It didn't work last time, so I'm giving it another chance!!!

Content.SourceString: 接下来就是——听天由命T^T
Content.LocalizedString: Now all that's left is… to leave it in the hands of fateeeee T^T

Content.SourceString: 结果一定会顺利的。
Content.LocalizedString: I'm sure the results will turn out well.

Content.SourceString: 嗯~突然间有种可可都这么说了，就一定会实现的预感！
Content.LocalizedString: Mmmm! I suddenly have this feeling that if Coco says it, it's definitely gonna come trueeeee!

Content.SourceString: 那决定好我们去吃什么了嘛？我提前做做功课~
Content.LocalizedString: Sooooo have we decided what we're eating yet? I wanna do some research in advance!

Content.SourceString: 让我想想……
Content.LocalizedString: Let me see…

Content.SourceString: 不急不急，想到了告诉我就好，接下来就交给我。
Content.LocalizedString: No rush, no rushhhhh! Just let me know when u decide, and I'll take care of the rest from thereeeee.

Content.SourceString: 我在美食攻略上下的功夫，绝对不亚于准备补考！
Content.LocalizedString: The effort I put into researching food spots is ABSOLUTELY no less than what I put into studying for my make-up exammmm!

Content.SourceString: 鼻子太灵总会有很多意想不到的烦恼。
Content.LocalizedString: Having such a sensitive nose always brings sooooo many unexpected problemssss.

Content.SourceString: 「郁闷.jpg」
Content.LocalizedString: depressed.jpg

Content.SourceString: 看来今天要在可丽饼的焦香味中入睡了。
Content.LocalizedString: Looks like I'm falling asleep to the toasty smell of crepes tonighttttt.

Content.SourceString: 焦香味？
Content.LocalizedString: Toasty smell?

Content.SourceString: 焦糊味。
Content.LocalizedString: Burnt smell actually.

Content.SourceString: 啊可可你不要点破这个！！！>口<
Content.LocalizedString: Ahhhh Coco don't call me out like that!!! >.<

Content.SourceString: 失手！是失手！只是失手而已！如果不是失手，绝对会很好吃！
Content.LocalizedString: It was a slip-up! Just a slip-uuuup! Simply an accident!!! If it wasn't for that tiny mistake, it would've been super delicious!!!

Content.SourceString: 我会怀念你当时看起来很好吃的样子的可丽饼，虽说你最终变得和锅底一样黑……
Content.LocalizedString: I'll always remember how delicious ur crepe LOOKED before it turned as black as the pan itself…

Content.SourceString: 当时发生了什么？
Content.LocalizedString: What happened back then?

Content.SourceString: 就是——我嗅到了点奇奇怪怪的味道，冲到锅前时已经晚了。
Content.LocalizedString: It was—I smelled something weirddd, but by the time I rushed to the stove it was already too lateeeee.

Content.SourceString: 颜色很漂亮的可丽饼突然从中间破了个大洞！然后从那个大洞里有火星子跳出来！洞被烧的越来越大，整张饼黑咕隆咚的！
Content.LocalizedString: The beautiful crepe suddenly got this HUGE hole in the middle! Then sparks started jumping out from it! The hole kept getting bigger and bigger until the whole thing was black as nightttt!

Content.SourceString: 这可能就是「黑洞」。
Content.LocalizedString: This must be what they call a "black hole."

Content.SourceString: 恭喜你发现了「黑洞」。
Content.LocalizedString: Congratulations on your discovery of a "black hole."

Content.SourceString: 我发现可可你很有讲冷笑话的天赋！
Content.LocalizedString: Lol Coco I've just discovered ur amazing talent for terrible dad jokes!

Content.SourceString: 既然如此，我要把它命名为「宇宙可丽饼」，真想撒点白芝麻当星星~
Content.LocalizedString: In that case, I'm gonna name it Cosmic Crepe! I really wish I could sprinkle some white sesame seeds on it as stars!

Content.SourceString: 哼哼~薄荷的灵机一动~简直完美~
Content.LocalizedString: Hehehe… Mint's stroke of genius!

Content.SourceString: 可惜它已经进入了垃圾桶QAQ
Content.LocalizedString: Too bad it's already in the Trash Can QAQ

Content.SourceString: 别灰心，当它是积累经验就好。
Content.LocalizedString: Don't be discouraged. Just think of it as gaining Exp.

Content.SourceString: 这是厨艺进步的必经之路。
Content.LocalizedString: It's a necessary path on the road to culinary improvement.

Content.SourceString: 早晚有一天！我的厨艺会修炼到能做出一桌美食的！
Content.LocalizedString: Just you wait!!! One day my cooking skills are gonna level up enough to make a wholeee feast of delicious food!!!

Content.SourceString: 不仅如此，还要有薄荷独家发明的创意菜！说着说着我好像又有灵机一动的好点子啦！
Content.LocalizedString: And not just that, I'm gonna create Mint's Exclusive Original Recipes too!!! Just talking about it now is giving me another stroke of geniusssss with an amazing ideaaa!

Content.SourceString: 如果可可很好奇猫粮是什么味道的话。
Content.LocalizedString: If ur curious about what cat food tastes likeeeee.

Content.SourceString: 答案是：千万别试！
Content.LocalizedString: The answer is: DON'T EVEN TRY IT!!!

Content.SourceString: 该怎么说呢，只是尝了一小颗，我眼前似乎就开始播放人生走马灯……
Content.LocalizedString: How do I even describe it… I just tried the tiniest bit, and my whole life started flashing before my eyesssss…

Content.SourceString: 罐头倒是挺好吃的，肉肉很丰富，稍微有点鱼腥味？
Content.LocalizedString: The canned stuff was actually pretty good tho, lots of meaty chunks, just a bit fishy-smelling?

Content.SourceString: 薄荷……
Content.LocalizedString: Mint…

Content.SourceString: 我们大家都很欢迎你来伊波恩吃饭。
Content.LocalizedString: We'd all be delighted to have you join us for a meal at Eibon.

Content.SourceString: 嗯嗯？怎么怎么？突然邀请我来吃饭！有什么庆祝活动吗？我是不会客气的哟！
Content.LocalizedString: Hmm? Anything happened? Suddenly inviting me for food! Is there something to celebrate? I won't hold back, just so u knowww!

Content.SourceString: 要好好吃饭，尽量别吃猫粮吧？
Content.LocalizedString: Make sure you eat properly, and try to avoid the cat food, okay?

Content.SourceString: 给猫猫留口吃的。
Content.LocalizedString: Save some for the kitties.

Content.SourceString: >口<！！！我才没有和小猫咪抢吃的！！！
Content.LocalizedString: >口<!!! I am NOT stealing food from the kittiesss!!!

Content.SourceString: 只是突然很好奇猫粮会是什么味道啦！
Content.LocalizedString: I was just suddenly super curious about what cat food tastes like!

Content.SourceString: 看它们吃那么香，就会忍不住想尝尝看嘛，就尝了那么一口。
Content.LocalizedString: They just looked sooooo happy eating it, I couldn't help but get curious and wanted to try some too! So I just had a teeny tiny bite.

Content.SourceString: 品尝的结论就是绝对不会有下次了ó﹏ò
Content.LocalizedString: And the conclusion is: there will NOT be a next time ó﹏ò

Content.SourceString: 话说回来，狗粮会和猫粮的味道区别很大吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Come to think of it, does dog food taste different from cat food???

Content.SourceString: 广告上的美味大骨头似乎很美味……
Content.LocalizedString: The Yummers Bone in that ads looks sooooo deliciousssss…

Content.SourceString: 不如亲口实践！
Content.LocalizedString: Why not try it yourself!

Content.SourceString: 给狗狗留口吃的。
Content.LocalizedString: Save some for the puppies.

Content.SourceString: 这个疑问就交给Agent.LUCK来解答吧！
Content.LocalizedString: Let's leave that question for Agent.LUCK!

Content.SourceString: 明天上班带点小礼物，装作不经意路过工位的时候顺便问问看……
Content.LocalizedString: Gonna bring a little gift to work tmr, then casually walk by and casually ask about it…

Content.SourceString: 我记得他最喜欢的那个牌子是……以前他的主人为他挑选的……
Content.LocalizedString: I remember his favorite brand is… the one his former owner used to pick out for him…

Content.SourceString: 薄荷选手，海特洛第一纸飞机制作大师！
Content.LocalizedString: Player Mint, Hethereau's #1 paper plane making master!

Content.SourceString: 把不及格考卷折成纸飞机飞走，郁闷通通飞走……
Content.LocalizedString: Folding my failing test papers into paper planes and watching them fly away… along with all my frustrations…

Content.SourceString: 哈~这下终于畅快啦！
Content.LocalizedString: Ahhhh… Now I'm finally feeling refreshed!

Content.SourceString: 把考卷飞走没关系吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Is it really okay to fly your test papers away?

Content.SourceString: 从小到大，我的考卷都乘着风飞向了遥远的地方！
Content.LocalizedString: Ever since I was little, my test papers have always taken flight and soared away on the breeze!

Content.SourceString: 根据我的多年经验，考卷才是制作纸飞机的最完美材料。
Content.LocalizedString: Based on my years of experience, test papers are THE perfect material for making paper planes.

Content.SourceString: 崭新的白纸，写满的草稿纸，这些都比不上新鲜出炉，被批得满满当当的考卷！
Content.LocalizedString: Fresh blank sheets, paper filled with notes… none of them compare to freshly graded test papers covered in red marks!

Content.SourceString: 可可要是有兴趣的话，下次我来伊波恩和你一起折！还可以叫上塔吉多，上次比赛他没赢过我，怪不服气呢。
Content.LocalizedString: If ur interested, Coco, I can come to Eibon next time and we can fold paper planes together! We could invite Taygedo too! He's still kinda salty about losing to me in the last competition.

OptionText.LocalizedString: I don't think I'm good at that…
I'm the real paper plane master here.

Content.SourceString: 我不太会……
Content.LocalizedString: I don't think I'm any good at that…

Content.SourceString: 我才是第一纸飞机制作大师。
Content.LocalizedString: I'm actually the best paper plane master.

Content.SourceString: 没关系没关系，我教你！
Content.LocalizedString: No worries, no worriesssss, I'll teach u!

Content.SourceString: 哦？薄荷选手接到了可可发来的挑战！那让我们比比看吧！
Content.LocalizedString: Ohhh? Player Mint has received Coco's challenge! Let's see who's betterrrr!

Content.SourceString: 哦不这下完蛋了完蛋了完蛋了！！！
Content.LocalizedString: I'm so dooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooomed.

Content.SourceString: 薰衣草小姐发消息叫我明天带着卷子去秘书室找她！说要帮我好好讲讲。
Content.LocalizedString: Lavender just messaged me saying I need to bring my test papers to the secretary's office tomorrow. She wants to go over them with me. I'm so doooooooooomed.

Content.SourceString: 让我想想我刚刚是在哪里放飞的纸飞机！现在赶回去说不定还能……
Content.LocalizedString: Let me think about where I flew that paper plane! If I rush back now, maybe I can still…

Content.SourceString: 晚了。
Content.LocalizedString: Too late.

Content.SourceString: 已经飞离了海特洛。
Content.LocalizedString: It's already flown out of Hethereau.

Content.SourceString: 可可你说得对。
Content.LocalizedString: Ur right, Coco.

Content.SourceString: 我打算跟着它飞离海特洛。
Content.LocalizedString: I'm gonna follow it and fly outta Hethereau myself.

Content.SourceString: 「瘫倒.jpg」
Content.LocalizedString: collapsed.jpg

Content.SourceString: 突发新闻：我连续中了五瓶畅爽汽水！
Content.LocalizedString: BREAKING NEWS: I just won five Refresh sodas in a rowwww!

Content.SourceString: 分我一瓶。
Content.LocalizedString: Share one with me.

Content.SourceString: 分我两瓶。
Content.LocalizedString: Share two with me.

Content.SourceString: 分我三瓶。
Content.LocalizedString: Share three with me.

Content.SourceString: 诶诶？可可要吗，我刚刚全都分给收容组的前辈们了。
Content.LocalizedString: Ehhhhh? U want some, Coco? I just gave them all away to my seniors in the CSU.

Content.SourceString: 等我下班给你带一瓶！
Content.LocalizedString: I'll bring u a bottle after my shift!

Content.SourceString: 只是开玩笑XD
Content.LocalizedString: Just kidding XD

Content.SourceString: 薄荷的好运气真让人羡慕。
Content.LocalizedString: I'm really envious of your good luck.

Content.SourceString: 运气好到我都在怀疑，说不定真的如前辈所说，我的命运已经和畅爽汽水牢牢系在了一起。
Content.LocalizedString: My luck is sooooo good. I'm starting to think my seniors might be right! Maybe my destiny really IS tied to Refresh soda forever!

Content.SourceString: 「疑问.jpg」
Content.LocalizedString: confused.jpg

Content.SourceString: 不然怎么会一打开就是「再来一瓶」，兑换后又是「再来一瓶」！
Content.LocalizedString: How else would I win soda after soda after soda!

Content.SourceString: 其实我手上还有一个留着没换呢，不然这无止尽的「再来一瓶」肯定刹不住车。
Content.LocalizedString: I actually still have a cap that I haven't redeemed yet, otherwise this endless chain of "free soda" would've never stopped!

Content.SourceString: 一想到无数瓶畅爽汽水正排着队等我兑换……呜哇！
Content.LocalizedString: Just thinking about all those Refresh sodas lined up waiting for me to redeem them… uwahhh!

Content.SourceString: 等等等等，难怪我那天只是站在售货机前就有一瓶从出货口滚出来。
Content.LocalizedString: Wait wait wait, no wonder a bottle randomly rolled out of the vending machine that day when I was just standing in front of it!

Content.SourceString: 果然没错！我已经被畅爽汽水缠上了！！！
Content.LocalizedString: I knew it! I've been chosen by Refresh soda!!!!!!

Content.SourceString: 不行不行，这个中奖瓶盖一定要封存起来！太可怕了！最近不宜买畅爽汽水，也不宜靠近售货机。
Content.LocalizedString: No way. This winning bottle cap must be sealed! It's too scary! I should avoid buying Refresh soda and stay away from vending machines for a while!

Content.SourceString: 不如我也喝番茄汁好了？虽说总看到安魂曲前辈在喝番茄百分百，但我还从来没尝过呢。
Content.LocalizedString: Maybe I should just drink tomato juice too? I always see Lacrimosa Senpai drinking Tomato 100, but I've never actually tried it myself.

Content.SourceString: 番茄百分百应该没有……呃……再来一袋的活动吧？
Content.LocalizedString: Tomato 100 probably doesn't have… uhhhh… "another pack!" promotions, right?

Content.SourceString: 也许……？
Content.LocalizedString: Maybe…?

Content.SourceString: 就算有，安魂曲前辈也会通通帮我解决掉的！
Content.LocalizedString: Even if they did, Lacrimosa Senpai would totally take care of them all for me!

Content.SourceString: 呀嚯~这里是薄荷！在呗果上我也要第一个向可可打招呼！
Content.LocalizedString: Yahoooo! Mint here! Gotta be the first one to say hello to Coco on Bagel too!

Content.SourceString: 你好。
Content.LocalizedString: Hello.

Content.SourceString: 薄荷不是第一个哦。
Content.LocalizedString: You're not the first one, Mint.

Content.SourceString: 嘿嘿，以后我们就别这么客气啦。
Content.LocalizedString: Hehehe, let's drop all the formalities from now on!

Content.SourceString: 居然有人比我的速度还快！
Content.LocalizedString: What! Someone's even faster than me!

Content.SourceString: 对了可可，我有点想知道在伊波恩的时候，那个……我身上是不是闻起来怪怪的？
Content.LocalizedString: Oh btw Coco, I kinda wanna know… when we were at Eibon, did I like… smell weird or something?

Content.SourceString: 因为我们痛揍塔吉多时也被他喷了好一通杀虫剂嘛。
Content.LocalizedString: I mean, we both got totally sprayed with insecticide when we were beating up Taygedo, righttt?

Content.SourceString: 我身上会不会都是那股难闻刺鼻的味道！哇！我不太想回忆……
Content.LocalizedString: Was I all stinky with that nasty sharp smell?! Ughhh! I don't even wanna think about it…

Content.SourceString: 似乎没什么奇怪的味道。
Content.LocalizedString: I don't think you smelled strange at all.

Content.SourceString: 不用太过担心。
Content.LocalizedString: Don't worry about it too much.

Content.SourceString: 杀虫剂很快就挥发了，放心。
Content.LocalizedString: Insecticides evaporate quickly, don't worry.

Content.SourceString: 没什么味道，就算有，大家也不会在意的。
Content.LocalizedString: I didn't notice any smell, and even if there was one, no one would've cared anyway.

Content.SourceString: 总之都怪塔吉多！
Content.LocalizedString: Anyway, it's all Taygedo's fault!

Content.SourceString: 害我回去加班的时候紧张了好久，生怕身上还带着杀虫剂的味道。
Content.LocalizedString: Made me sooooo nervous when I went back to work overtime, kept worrying I still smelled like bug spray all over!

Content.SourceString: 明明特意加快脚步绕回家洗澡换过衣服的说，但就是怕万一呢！
Content.LocalizedString: I mean, I literally rushed home to shower and change clothes! But u still worry about these things, ya knowww?!

Content.SourceString: 一想到那种刺刺麻麻的感觉，我尾巴上的毛就要炸起来了！
Content.LocalizedString: Just thinking about that tingly, itchy feeling makes the fur on my tail stand straight up!!!

Content.SourceString: 不过话说回来，当时发现我们的幸亏是塔吉多？
Content.LocalizedString: But wait, thinking back on it… was it actually kinda lucky that Taygedo was the one who found us???

Content.SourceString: 塔吉多的威胁力……嘿嘿，不过如此！
Content.LocalizedString: Taygedo's threat level… hehehe, not so scary after all!

Content.SourceString: 打个比方，当时在场的如果是局里的维修师布洛凯德，肯定会一舌头把我们卷走吃掉吧！
Content.LocalizedString: Like, if it had been Barracuda from the bureau there instead, he totally would've rolled up his tongue and swallowed us whole!

Content.SourceString: 绝对不要小看蜥蜴维修员的威力！
Content.LocalizedString: NEVER underestimate the power of the lizard guy!

Content.SourceString: 蜥蜴维修员？
Content.LocalizedString: Lizard guy?

Content.SourceString: 就是布洛凯德啦！套用一下安魂曲前辈的叫法，嘿嘿嘿。
Content.LocalizedString: I'm talking about Barracuda! Just borrowing what Lacrimosa Senpai calls him, hehehe.

Content.SourceString: 异象管理局听起来很有趣。
Content.LocalizedString: The bureau sounds interesting.

Content.SourceString: 那当然！不仅是有趣，为我们能打起精神加班而填满咖啡杯的菲女士，办事认真可靠的翳先生，还有组里总是包容我的前辈们，大家都非常温暖呢！
Content.LocalizedString: Of course! More than interesting! There's Ms. Fei who keeps our coffee cups full so we can power through overtime, super dependable Skia Senpai who takes his work seriously, and all my seniors in the department who always put up with me. Everyone's sooooo warm and welcoming!

Content.SourceString: 对了对了，关于那个找我写推荐信的约定……
Content.LocalizedString: Oh oh oh! About that promise where I'd write you a recommendation letter…

Content.SourceString: 永久有效哦！嘿嘿~
Content.LocalizedString: It's valid forever! Hehehe!

Content.SourceString: 重大发现！「菲林轨迹」恢复营业了！
Content.LocalizedString: BIG NEWS! Film Orbit Studio is back in business!

Content.SourceString: 生意真是好的出奇耶！我还是头一次看到门口排那么长的队！
Content.LocalizedString: Business is crazyyyy good! I've never seen such a long line at the entrance before!!!

Content.SourceString: 原本是打算顺路看看，要是有空闲的话顺便更新下证件照，没想到预约都排到下周了。
Content.LocalizedString: I was just planning to stop by on my way, maybe update my ID photo if they weren't busy… but nope! Appointments are booked all the way till next week.

OptionText.LocalizedString: Only if Eibon's business was this good.

Content.SourceString: 生意这么火爆？
Content.LocalizedString: Business is that booming?

Content.SourceString: 这么好的生意伊波恩也想有。
Content.LocalizedString: Only if Eibon's business was this good.

Content.SourceString: 大家都在传店主得到了一台超厉害的异象相机，能拍出客人绝对满意的照片！
Content.LocalizedString: Everyone's saying the owner got this SUPER powerful anomaly camera that takes photos customers are absolutely in love with!

Content.SourceString: 加上店里多布置了几个新置景，开启折扣活动，生意很难不火爆！
Content.LocalizedString: Plus they added some new photo sets, launched a discount promo… business was bound to blow up!

Content.SourceString: 可惜是限时折扣，万一结束前排不到我……
Content.LocalizedString: Too bad it's a limited-time discount… what if it ends before I can even get an appointment…

Content.SourceString: 不，队排得那么长，绝对不会排到我的。
Content.LocalizedString: No wayyyyy, the line is so long I'll definitely never get my turn.

Content.SourceString: 「郁闷脸.jpg」
Content.LocalizedString: depressed.jpg

Content.SourceString: 我有五折优惠：）
Content.LocalizedString: I can get you a fifty percent discount :)

Content.SourceString: 欸什么什么！五折！可可你是中了那家店的招待券吗！
Content.LocalizedString: Whaaaaat! FIFTY PERCENT?! Coco, did you win some kind of VIP voucher from that place or something?!

Content.SourceString: 塔吉多也有；）
Content.LocalizedString: Taygedo has one too ;)

Content.SourceString: 别吊我胃口啦可可！！
Content.LocalizedString: Don't leave me hanging like that, Coco!!!

Content.SourceString: 伊波恩人人都享受五折优惠XD
Content.LocalizedString: Everyone at Eibon gets fifty percent off XD

Content.SourceString: 我现在要申请成为伊波恩的编外成员！
Content.LocalizedString: I'm officially applying to be an external member of Eibon!

Content.SourceString: 是我们帮店主解决了异象惹的小麻烦，店主作为答谢给了我们五折优惠。
Content.LocalizedString: We helped the shop owner solve a little problem caused by an anomaly, and they gave us a fifty percent discount as thanks.

Content.SourceString: 原来~是这样！
Content.LocalizedString: Ohhhhh I get it now!

Content.SourceString: 惹了……小麻烦？是异象在捣乱而不是店主得到了超厉害的异象照相机吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Wait… a little problem? So the anomaly was causing trouble instead of the owner having some super powerful anomaly camera?

Content.SourceString: 正是如此。
Content.LocalizedString: Yup.

Content.SourceString: 好失望哦，我原本想让异象相机给我拍张绝对好看的证件照呢。
Content.LocalizedString: Sooooo disappointed! I was really hoping that anomaly camera could take me the most perfect ID photo ever!

Content.SourceString: 现在的证件照……看上去呆呆的。
Content.LocalizedString: My current ID photo… I look so dumb in it.

Content.SourceString: 得知真相后好像也没那么想拍了！更何况是排到下周的漫长队伍！
Content.LocalizedString: Now that I know the truth, I'm not even that excited about getting photos taken anymore! Especially with that looooong line going all the way to next week!

Content.SourceString: 没办法，谁让当时大家的「我听说……」那么自然地飘进我的耳朵里啦！
Content.LocalizedString: Can't help it, okay?! It's not my fault all those rumors that just naturally floated into my ears!

Content.SourceString: 要是一开始就没有期待，也不会这么失望！现在……他们说的我都听不见！
Content.LocalizedString: If I hadn't gotten my hopes up in the first place, I wouldn't be this disappointed! Now… I'm totally tuning out everything they're saying!

Content.SourceString: 薄荷大厨晋升计划，启动！
Content.LocalizedString: Operation: Chef Mint's Promotion, COMMENCE!

Content.SourceString: 薄荷大厨？
Content.LocalizedString: Chef Mint?

Content.SourceString: 薄荷很会做饭？
Content.LocalizedString: Are you good at cooking?

Content.SourceString: 未来总会是大厨！
Content.LocalizedString: I'm gonna be a top chef someday!

Content.SourceString: 将来肯定很会做饭！
Content.LocalizedString: I'm definitely gonna be an amazing cook in the future!

Content.SourceString: 因为我抢到了这个！当当当当！《美食美味炼金术》！这可是星级大厨的私房菜谱哟！
Content.LocalizedString: Because I snagged this! Ta-da-da-daaaa! "Art of Delichemy"! This is actually a top-class chef's secret recipe collection!

Content.SourceString: 听起来好像有点耳熟……
Content.LocalizedString: That sounds kinda familiar…

Content.SourceString: 白贝壳星级餐厅美味炼金术主厨凯尼斯，之前超级火的！呗果上十条新闻热帖，八条都是他餐厅升星的消息！
Content.LocalizedString: Kenneth, the head chef of La Palourde Blanche who wrote "Art of Delichemy," was SUPER famous before! Like, eight out of ten trending posts on Bagel were about his restaurant getting more stars!

Content.SourceString: 听采访上讲，为了研发那道一举斩获所有评委味蕾的新菜，他试菜试到自己的味觉都消失了！哇~不敢想象那是怎样的美味！好想尝尝看哦~
Content.LocalizedString: In his interview, he said he tested his new dish so many times that his taste buds completely disappeared! All to create that masterpiece that won over every critic! I can't even imagine how amazing it must taste! I wanna try it soooo bad!

Content.SourceString: 餐厅预约已经爆满，现在只能约到整整一年后的位置了。
Content.LocalizedString: The restaurant is completely booked up! You can only get a reservation for exactly one year from now!!!

Content.SourceString: 虽说就算约的到，我的工资肯定负担不起T^T
Content.LocalizedString: Not that it matters anyway… Even if I could get a reservation, my salary could NEVER cover it T^T

Content.SourceString: 不过别担心！他的烹饪书我还是负担得起的！
Content.LocalizedString: But don't worry! I can still afford his cookbook at least!

Content.SourceString: 「为了让所有渴望品尝餐食的食客不留遗憾，特意出版了这本烹饪书，希望所有人都能掌握美妙的炼金秘诀。」呜呜呜主厨真是大好人！
Content.LocalizedString: "I published this cookbook so that all food enthusiasts can enjoy these dishes without regret, and to share these wonderful alchemy secrets with everyone." Awwww the chef is such an amazing person!

Content.SourceString: 原来是这样的说辞。
Content.LocalizedString: So that's the pitch they're going with.

Content.SourceString: 等我学成出山，请你吃饭吼！让我们也不要留下不能坐在美味炼金术享受美食的遗憾。
Content.LocalizedString: Once I master my skills and make my debut, I'm sooo treating you to dinner! Let's not miss our chance to experience the wonders of Delichemy together!

Content.SourceString: 我很期待。
Content.LocalizedString: I'm excited.

Content.SourceString: 期待是当然的~但也别太期待！给我多留一些进步的空间……
Content.LocalizedString: Of course you should be excited! But don't get TOO excited! Gimme some room to grow…

Content.SourceString: 有人刚刚把糖罐打翻啦啊啊啊啊啊O.o
Content.LocalizedString: Someone just knocked the sugar jar over O.o

Content.SourceString: 主厨没有说这个时候该怎么补救耶！该怎么办该怎么办，锅里面全糊了！！！
Content.LocalizedString: The chef never said what to do when this happens! What do I do what do I doooo, everything in the pan is burning!

Content.SourceString: 先不聊了，厨房要着了！
Content.LocalizedString: Gotta go, the kitchen's about to burn down!

Content.SourceString: 啊~实在是太在意了！我好想知道！
Content.LocalizedString: Ahhhhh… I just can't stop thinking about it! I need to know!

Content.SourceString: 塔吉多最近是怎么啦？我嗅到了「有事发生」的不寻常气味！绝对有！
Content.LocalizedString: What's up with Taygedo lately? I'm getting a strong whiff of "something's happening" vibes! There's definitely something going on!!!

Content.SourceString: 在露营地打扫的时候，被随心泥腌入味了吧。
Content.LocalizedString: Maybe you're just smelling the Imaginadough that soaked into everything when we were cleaning the campsite.

Content.SourceString: 失恋的塔吉多通过狂吃海胆缓解心中的痛苦。
Content.LocalizedString: Heartbroken Taygedo is trying to ease his pain by binge-eating sea urchins.

Content.SourceString: 随心泥失控的事我也有听说，在那里的橡皮泥味散干净前，我下班后都不想去那边散步了！
Content.LocalizedString: I heard about that Imaginadough going haywire too! I'm sooo not taking walks over there after work until that dough smell finally disappears!

Content.SourceString: 可能他身上都是海胆味。
Content.LocalizedString: He probably reeks of sea urchin by now.

Content.SourceString: 塔吉多收集那么多随心泥是要干嘛？
Content.LocalizedString: What's Taygedo planning to do with all that Imaginadough they've been collecting?

Content.SourceString: 等等！塔吉多什么时候……？
Content.LocalizedString: Wait! When did Taygedo…?

Content.SourceString: 当然是为了……一场盛大的，名为「制造回忆」实为意图表白的表演秀。
Content.LocalizedString: Obviously for… a grand spectacle called "Creating Memories" that's actually just an elaborate confession of love.

Content.SourceString: 恋爱、失恋？欸欸欸……怎么突然间发生了这么多事！
Content.LocalizedString: Love? Heartbreak?? Whaaaaaat… how did all this happen so suddenly?!

OptionText.LocalizedString: Not as complicated as I thought

Content.SourceString: 虽说结果……相信你能想象得到。
Content.LocalizedString: Though as for the result… well, I'm sure you can imagine how that turned out.

Content.SourceString: 没想象中那么复杂，也许只是有过一场最终导致我们打扫了好几天卫生的露营地表白。
Content.LocalizedString: It's not as complicated as you might think… just a confession at the campsite that ended with us cleaning up for days afterward.

Content.SourceString: 原来如此，我大概明白了塔吉多那天为什么会那样。
Content.LocalizedString: Ohhhhh, now I get why Taygedo was acting that way that day.

Content.SourceString: 可怜的小海獭。
Content.LocalizedString: Poor little otter. :(

Content.SourceString: 「哭哭脸.jpg」
Content.LocalizedString: crying.jpg

Content.SourceString: 塔吉多怎么了？
Content.LocalizedString: What's wrong with Taygedo?

Content.SourceString: 塔吉多突然说要重新启动我们的「超人日记」变强修行特训，首先从绕桥间地跑一圈开始。
Content.LocalizedString: Taygedo suddenly announced he's restarting our "Superhero Diary" power-up training program! First step: run a lap around Bridge Crossings.

Content.SourceString: 我原本想提议我们先热热身活动活动，没想到他直接冲了出去！
Content.LocalizedString: I was about to suggest we warm up first, but he just ZOOMED off before I could say anything!!!

Content.SourceString: 虽说追上马力全开的塔吉多也不是什么难事啦。
Content.LocalizedString: I mean, catching up to Taygedo even at full throttle isn't exactly a challenge for meeeee.

Content.SourceString: 但该怎么说呢……？我还是第一次看到塔吉多这么积极！追上去问他他也不接话。
Content.LocalizedString: But how do I put this…? I've NEVER seen Taygedo this motivated before! When I caught up and asked him what's going on, he totally ignored meeeee.

Content.SourceString: 看来塔吉多通过闷头跑步发泄情绪。
Content.LocalizedString: Looks like Taygedo is blowing off steam by running himself into the ground.

Content.SourceString: 得知他失恋后，倒也不是不能理解啦。
Content.LocalizedString: Now that I know he got his heart broken, I totally get why he's acting like thissss.

Content.SourceString: 或者说，因为失恋才这么迫切地想变强特训吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Soooo is he doing this whole "gotta get stronger" training thing BECAUSE of his heartbreak?

Content.SourceString: 他当时跑着跑着摔了个倒栽葱。明明爬起来都费劲，还强撑着要继续下去，说不管怎么样至少要完成今天的特训！
Content.LocalizedString: He was running along when he totally face-planted right into the ground! Even though he could barely get back up, he INSISTED on continuing, saying he HAD to complete today's training no matter whattttt!

Content.SourceString: 摔得那么惨还能继续吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Could he really keep going after such a nasty fall?

Content.SourceString: 有我在，当然没问题！扛着他接着跑完全不在话下！
Content.LocalizedString: With ME there? No problem at all! Carrying him while finishing the run was a piece of cakeeeee!

Content.SourceString: 而且，感觉我们跑完后塔吉多的表情放松了很多哦~嘿嘿，意外帮他好好放松了心情呢。
Content.LocalizedString: And after we finished our run, Taygedo's expression looked wayyyyy more relaxed! Hehe, looks like I accidentally helped him relax a bit.

Content.SourceString: 说起来塔吉多怎么还没回我消息？今晚打算约在什么时候？变强修行特训每天都要坚持才行！
Content.LocalizedString: Hey, why hasn't Taygedo texted me back yet?? What time are we meeting tonight? We gotta stick to our power-up training EVERY single dayyyy!

Content.SourceString: 没看呗果？还是手机没电了？
Content.LocalizedString: Did u miss my text?? Or is ur phone deaddd?

Content.SourceString: 可可你现在在店里吗？要不帮我问问？
Content.LocalizedString: Coco, u at the store right now? Can u ask for me plzzz?

Content.SourceString: 虽说答案似乎显而易见……
Content.LocalizedString: Though the answer seems pretty obvious…

Content.SourceString: 要是没猜错的话，塔吉多只是装作没看见XD
Content.LocalizedString: If I had to guess, Taygedo's just pretending not to see your messages XD

Content.SourceString: 可可，你和娜娜莉明天下午有没有空呀~
Content.LocalizedString: Coco, do you and Nanally have time tomorrow afternoon?

Content.SourceString: 我听娜娜莉说这段时间一直闷在伊波恩，都要长蘑菇啦。
Content.LocalizedString: I heard Nanally has been stuck in Eibon for a while. She's gonna grow mold!

Content.SourceString: 要是娜娜莉身体条件允许的话，你们要不要来我家玩？
Content.LocalizedString: If Nanally is feeling good enough, how about you come to my place for a party?

Content.SourceString: 我准备了个超级超级超级好玩的游戏！保证你们会喜欢！
Content.LocalizedString: I prepared a super duper omega fun game! I swear you'd love it!

Content.SourceString: 不过我家可能会有点远，因为我最近搬家啦~
Content.LocalizedString: But I just moved recently, and my place is a bit far!

Content.SourceString: 稍等我把地址发给你们！等你们来哟！！
Content.LocalizedString: I'll send you the address in a minute. I'll be waiting for you!

Content.SourceString: 好头疼呀，好头疼呀~
Content.LocalizedString: Ugh, my head's killing me…

Content.SourceString: 薄荷现在非常困扰！不知道有没有人能给点好建议呢~
Content.LocalizedString: Mint's in a real pickle right now! Anyone got any advice for me?

Content.SourceString: <Blue>「碧波之星沙滩排球大赛」</>
Content.LocalizedString: <Blue>Jade Star: Beach Volleyball Tournament</>

Content.SourceString: 果然还是你懂我呢可可！
Content.LocalizedString: Coco, you get me!

Content.SourceString: 这就过去找你！等我两分钟！！！
Content.LocalizedString: I'll be there in two minutes!

Content.SourceString: 等一下，我上面的字还没打完……
Content.LocalizedString: Hold on, I still have something to say…

Content.SourceString: ……薄荷？
Content.LocalizedString: …Mint?

Content.SourceString: 可可可可可可！大新闻！
Content.LocalizedString: Coco! Coco! Coco! Big news!

Content.SourceString: DSD潮玩出新品了！我保证，超级好玩！
Content.LocalizedString: DSD POP just dropped a new toy! Trust me, it's a blast!

Content.SourceString: 可可要是有空的话，一起来玩吧！
Content.LocalizedString: If you're free, Coco, come play with me!

Content.SourceString: 在哪里？我马上就来。
Content.LocalizedString: Where? I'll be right over!

Content.SourceString: OK~这就发你地址！等你来哦可可，让我们一起玩个痛快吧！
Content.LocalizedString: OK~ Sending you the address now! Can't wait to see you, Coco. Let's have a blast!
